headline: The PP Casts Doubt on the Pension System: Calls for Being “Brave” to “Change” the Model Because It “Is Going to Blow Up”
summary: PP leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo promised to guarantee the current pension system, while party figure Ester Muñoz says reform must be addressed bravely. The debate follows Vox's proposal of a mixed model.
why: Pension policy affects Spain's public finances, social security spending and long-term government debt, which matter for sovereign bond investors.

original_headline: El PP pone en duda el sistema de pensiones: pide ser "valientes" para "cambiar" el modelo porque "va a petar"
